## History

Before coming to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), James lived in Scottsford, [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), where his sister kept house for him until her death. On her deathbed, his sister made him promise to get married, leading him to marry [Emily](../character/emily.md) Scott and take a two-week wedding trip to St. John. Having visited Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) as a boy and enjoyed it, he later relocated to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after separating from [Emily](../character/emily.md) when she demanded he choose between her and his parrot, [Ginger](../character/ginger.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P58](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0058), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)_
